prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style: hand-painted stylized game art, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, mid-level detail, softer muted colours with gentle saturation, epic and luminous, never grim. The palette's warm gold and cool teal are painted into the surfaces, but the light is flat, even studio light: no strong key light, no cast shadows, no rim light. Use the attached images only as reference as described: the first attachment is always the style reference for palette and brushwork; later attachments are the approved designs to keep. Material swatch sheet, wide landscape 16:9, plain light neutral grey background. Square swatch tiles in a neat grid, evenly spaced, each flat-on (orthographic, no perspective, no horizon, no shadows from outside the tile), a seamless tileable painterly texture with edges that would wrap, broad clumped brushwork, no tiny high-frequency noise, a short neat label under each. Swatches: Redraw of the attached reference sheet to the current spec: keep exactly the same swatches, their order and their materials. Meadow biome terrain, four square tiles in one row, labels exactly as written in quotes: "Meadow Ground" (soft meadow grass seen straight down, muted green-gold clumped brushwork with a few sparse tiny wildflower and clover specks, kept soft so characters read on it); "Meadow Path" (a close-up of bare worn packed earth filling the entire tile, warm ochre-tan with a few pale pebbles scattered evenly; the tile is all earth, it is not a picture of a path, no grass strips on either side); "Limestone Cliff / Lip" (pale warm cream limestone face, softly weathered layered blocks with painted cracks and a few moss flecks, no turf band); "Limestone Underside" (pale cream limestone, rougher, washed evenly with cool teal, ivy and root streaks spread evenly over the tile). Each tile is one evenly spread texture filling the whole square edge to edge, seen straight on with no perspective, no horizon, no focal point, no border, no single path or band crossing it and no light gradient, so its left edge would wrap onto its right and its top onto its bottom. Title at the top: "Meadow terrain".
